correct_completion: did the committee announce its decision.
full_sentence: Only after the final vote, did the committee announce its decision.
acceptable_variants: did the members finally publish their decision.
did the decision come out at last.

options.why_wrong: After 'only after', the auxiliary must come before the subject, so normal word order is ungrammatical.

options.text: did the committee announce its decision.
the committee was announcing its decision.
options.why_wrong: The continuous form does not carry the inverted structure required after 'only after'.

options.text: it was announced its decision by the committee.
options.why_wrong: This is an incorrect passive form that does not use the inversion required here.

explanation: After 'only after', the auxiliary verb precedes the subject to emphasise the time of the action.
translation: Somente depois da votação final é que a comissão anunciou a sua decisão.
